channel.title: Clarion Project – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Clarion Project – Bias and Credibility (clarionproject.org)

item.title: Old Dominion University Shooting Suspect Had Previous Terrorism Conviction
item.description: Mohamed Bailor Jalloh, former Virginia National Guard member, was identified as suspect in deadly shooting at Old Dominion University in Va.

item.title: Two Men Charged in Plot to Use Explosives During New York Protest
item.description: Emir Balat and Ibrahim Kayumi of Pennsylvania were charged with providing material support to ISIS and explosive devices offenses.

item.title: Austin Gunman Kills Two, Wounds 14
item.description: Ndiaga Diagne of Texas opened fire outside a bar in Austin, killing two people and wounding 14 others before being shot and killed by police.

item.title: Nine Antifa Cell Members Convicted in Attack on Texas ICE Detention Center
item.description: 9 members of North Texas Antifa cell were convicted for their roles in July 4, 2025, attack on the Prairieland ICE Detention Center in Texas.

item.title: Michigan Man Identified in Vehicle Ramming and Shooting at Synagogue
item.description: Ayman Mohamad Ghazali, a naturalized U.S. citizen from Lebanon, was identified as the suspect in March 12 attack at Michigan Temple Israel.

item.title: Two Jewish Men Assaulted at Santana Row in Possible Hate Crime
item.description: 2 Israeli American, Lior Zeevi and Daniel Levy, were attacked on Feb. 8, 2026, outside Augustine restaurant at Santana Row in California.

item.title: Armed Man in Tactical Gear Arrested After Entering Texas Elementary School
item.description: A man wearing tactical-style clothing and carrying a firearm entered Texas Elementary School through an unsecured door on March 10.

item.title: FBI Investigates Student Linked to Potential Violence Plans at Siena University
item.description: Dawson Maloney, former student of Siena University in Loudonville, N.Y., was identified with potential plans of violence at the university.

item.title: Iranian Intelligence Agent Convicted in U.S. Assassination Plot
item.description: An Iranian intelligence operative, Asif Merchant, was convicted for involvement in a murder-for-hire plot targeting U.S. politicians.

item.title: Meta Disrupts Iranian Social Media Influence Campaign Targeting U.S. Users
item.description: Meta said it removed a network of fake Instagram accounts linked to Iranian influence operation that targeted U.S. users and other countries.
